candidate_selection: Lowest selected validation CRPS; improvement must exceed min_delta; ties keep earlier candidate. Epoch selection keeps the existing median/mean RMSE guards.
diagnostics: Replay patience=3 on longer_training to isolate early stopping. Also report minimum median-RMSE epoch of each trajectory, without using it for model selection.
test_policy: Freeze all four candidate choices before any held-out forecasts. Repeat selected settings with training seeds 42,43,44; select each seed's checkpoint on its training-battery validation only. No full-data refit.
limitation: These four batteries have been inspected in earlier experiments; this is a controlled follow-up, not a new independent benchmark.
